ns2:course.label: Workshop-Tutorial
ns2:course.description: (L A S 110) Independent study and experimental seminars open to Unit One students and to others; specific offerings vary each term. Credit toward college or departmental requirements is contingent upon approval by the appropriate unit. A total of 12 hours of LAS 110 credit may be applied toward graduation in the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Unit One students or consent of Unit One Director.
